title: Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?
abstract: arXiv:2611.33031v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding err

translated_title: 前沿大语言模型能否通过无工具的权重空间编程修复量化网络？
translated_abstract: 我们将Claude家族的四个大语言模型（LLM）以文本形式提供了具有2万参数的CIFAR-10卷积神经网络的完整权重，并要求它们在没有工具、数据或运行推理能力的情况下生成一个4比特网络。标准的舍入到最近（RTN）4比特量化会将测试准确率从81.4%降低到60.4%。我们设计了四种评估协议，它们在提供给LLM的输入和任务描述上有所不同，并分析它们的响应。在前两种协议中，LLM被提供了浮点网络和4比特RTN网络，并被告知准确率显著下降。在后两种协议中，它们只收到浮点网络和量化该网络的任务，这用于测试它们是自己主动应用优化，还是退回到普通的RTN。我们的分析表明，前沿LLM能够恢复大部分损失的准确率。在每层给出一个答案的情况下，Opus 5.5通过平衡舍入误差将4比特网络的准确率提升至77.95%。
tldr: 该研究证明前沿大语言模型无需任何工具、数据或推理能力，仅凭权重空间编程即可将4比特量化CNN的准确率从60.4%恢复至77.95%，接近原始浮点模型的81.4%水平。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that a frontier LLM can repair a 4-bit quantized CNN through tool-free weight-space programming, recovering accuracy from 60.4% to 77.95%—close to the original 81.4%—without any tools, data, or inference capability.
